the simulation of a multipath fading channel can be performed in the time-domain by means of the following steps: 1. Generate a random sequence of complex numbers representing the multipath channel taps. 2. Convolve the sequence of complex channel taps with the transmitted signal.

a) the performance of a communication system can be evaluated by means of accurate software simulations; b) the performance of the system can be evaluated in a wide range of propagation conditions by means of software simulations that can be done with a few lines of MATLAB code; c) software simulations are an important step for the design of a communication system and can be done at an early design stage; and d) the software simulations can be done with the aid of a MATLAB toolbox.
